data.description: Per-element countdown timer. Renders a ticking days/hours/minutes/seconds display targeting the supplied datetime.

data-aed-cd-card.description: Render the boxed card layout (separate cells per unit) instead of inline text.

data-aed-cd-expired.description: Text shown after the target datetime passes.

data-aed-cd-hide-on-expire.description: Remove the element from the page after expiry instead of swapping the text.
